Let $S$ be a scheme.
Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian algebraic space over $S$.
The following are equivalent
\begin{enumerate}
\item $X$ is regular, and
\item every \'etale local ring $\mathcal{O}_{X, \overline{x}}$ is
regular.
\end{enumerate}

Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian algebraic space over $S$.

statement:
Here $X_\etale$ denotes the small étale site of the algebraic space $X$ and $\mathcal O_X$ the structure sheaf on that site where applicable; a geometric point and a stalk are as defined in §19.

Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$.
Let $x \in |X|$ be a point. The following are equivalent
\begin{enumerate}
\item $X$ is regular at $x$, and
\item the \'etale local ring $\mathcal{O}_{X, \overline{x}}$ is
regular for any (equivalently some) geometric point $\overline{x}$
lying over $x$.
\end{enumerate}

lying over $x$.
semantic_review_note: Regularity of X at one topological point x is equivalent to regularity of the étale local ring at ANY (equivalently SOME) geometric point above x, keeping the distinction between local regularity and global regularity.

\label{lemma-regular-normal}
A regular algebraic space is normal.
